name: cipher-pathwise
description: PathWise — delivery planning for Waypoint Group (Team Cipher, Tech-Triathlon 2026)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pathwise/core && npm run build -w @pathwise/api && npm run build -w @pathwise/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @pathwise/core && concurrently -n api,web -c teal,magenta "npm run dev -w @pathwise/api" "npm run dev -w @pathwise/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pathwise/core && npm run test -w @pathwise/api
